# Teum

Teum is a dense, monochrome React component and interaction system for product interfaces.

## Documentation routes

- / - public overview, behavior principles, and product demo
- /#installation - verified pinned-registry quickstart, CSS setup, troubleshooting, and update safety
- /#choosing-components - task, focus, and recovery boundaries between adjacent components
- /#product-pilot - Teum Data primitives plus Issues Workspace, Customer Directory, and Audit Log recipes
- /#analytics - Teum Analytics primitives plus SaaS Overview, Product Usage, and Conversion & Retention recipes
- /#product-patterns - Customer Workspace, Billing & Usage, and Members & Permissions B2B compositions
- /#agent-native - machine-readable contracts, selection and composition rules, Teum skill, and 30-task evaluation
- /#foundations - color, typography, spacing, motion, and Component DNA
- /#button - component documentation begins with Button; the sidebar lists all 45 components
- /#patterns - interaction patterns
- /#component-status - maturity, evidence, and promotion gates
- /#accessibility - keyboard, focus, motion, contrast, and manual review
- /#browser-support - browser and viewport support policy
- /#security - vulnerability reporting and supported versions
- /#contributing - contribution and review requirements
- /#releases - versioning, evidence, deprecation, and support windows
- /#licensing - MIT permissions and third-party responsibilities

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@4.18.0 registry add @teum-pinned=https://teum.minwookshin.com/r/v/0.1.0-rc.22/{name}.json
npx shadcn@4.18.0 add @teum-pinned/button
```

Executable starters:

- examples/quickstart-vite
- examples/quickstart-next

Before accepting an update, run the install with `--dry-run`, inspect the target file with `--diff <path>`, then use `--overwrite --yes` only after review. Teum does not automatically merge copied source.

Install the Teum Data vertical slice:

```bash
npx shadcn@4.18.0 add @teum-pinned/teum-data
```

Teum Data exposes Data Table, Filter Builder, Data Toolbar, Bulk Action Bar, Date Range Filter, Data Export Menu, Motion Contract v1, a versioned view-state codec, and three agent-readable recipe contracts. Issues Workspace proves mutation and recovery; Customer Directory proves controlled server state, URL state, and saved views; Audit Log proves date filtering and 10,000-row virtualization. The 45-component Core catalog remains frozen.

Install the complete B2B Product Patterns slice:

```bash
npx shadcn@4.18.0 add @teum-pinned/teum-product-patterns
npx shadcn@4.18.0 add @teum-pinned/teum-agent

Agent contract:
https://teum.minwookshin.com/agent/teum-agent.json
```

Product Patterns composes the approved Core, Data, and Analytics layers into Customer Workspace, Billing & Usage, and Members & Permissions. Its machine-readable contract records task sequence, state ownership, invariants, failure handling, keyboard behavior, and reduced-motion behavior.

This exact namespace/install path is exercised in a fresh React + TypeScript + Vite consumer before release. Installed component source imports the shared contract and its scoped stylesheet. The complete-system item also provides `styles/teum.css` as the application-root base entry. Plain CSS is the source of truth; Tailwind CSS v4 consumers may additionally install `@teum-pinned/teum-tailwind` for semantic utilities backed by the same variables.

Every component route ends with a copyable pinned-registry install command, common props and defaults, the compiler-extracted public surface, verified dependency versions, and the remaining manual review boundary. Section links use `/#<route>/<section>`, for example `/#installation/troubleshooting`.
